evidence: Per-arm score_completion JSON durations, immutable dispatch resource records and file timestamps. ORIGINAL finished before DEDUP collection/resource verification completed; the configured maximum of four score workers was not reached.

benchmark_limitation: These are observed task phase wall times; rendering contention and different geometries preclude treating them as isolated compute benchmarks.
